dialog.6.de.1.n: spielen = to play (a game or an instrument) — both
dialog.6.de.3.n: Gitarre spielen = to play the guitar (no article)
grammar.0.intro: spielen is regular. With lesen, e → ie with du and er.
grammar.0.note: du liest — not „du lest“. (essen, nehmen, lesen, sprechen — a family of verbs where e changes to i/ie.)
grammar.1.text: gern = like to. nicht gern = don't like to: „Ich spiele nicht gern Fußball.“ — nicht comes right after the verb, before gern. Where Bangla says “don't love to”, German says „nicht gern“.
grammar.2.title: Hobby verbs
quiz.6.why: nicht gern — after the verb, before the noun.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “I like listening to music.”
